data.title: Unveiling the Constant of Circular Proportions
data.description: Analyze the proportional relationship between a circle's perimeter and its linear span by measuring and comparing dimensions across multiple figures to discover the foundation of pi.

challenges.narration: A clock face is shaped like this circle.
challenges.instruction: Unroll the circumference, then find how many diameters fit around: C ÷ d.
challenges.hint: Divide the circumference by the diameter. For EVERY circle this ratio is the same — a little more than 3.
